provenance.author: BoardFlow
sources: Heat: Pedal to the Metal rulebook (Days of Wonder, via RulesPal)

steps.note: First game: USA track; consider racing just 1 lap

steps.text: Check the board for how many Heat and Stress cards each car gets (typically 6 Heat and 3 Stress)
Remaining Stress cards faceup near the board as a reserve
Each player: a car, player mat, Gear pawn, 12 Basic cards and 3 Starting Upgrade cards in their color
Shuffle your Basic, Starting Upgrade and Stress cards as your draw deck on the mat's left spot
Heat cards faceup on the Engine spot; Gear pawn in first gear
Place the cars on the starting grid at random, filling spots in ascending order - this is the first round's player order
Experienced drivers can remove 1-2 Heat from their car to even things out
Everyone secretly shifts gear and chooses cards for round 1
